Metadata.title: AMS Airport Ride — Schiphol Taxi with Fixed Price
Metadata.description: Book your Schiphol taxi with a fixed price from €35. Also for regular taxi rides within Amsterdam and between Dutch cities. Pay easily after your ride.

Why.title: Your airport transfer, without the hassle.
Why.intro: From your front door to Schiphol and back again. We keep the booking simple, the price clear and the journey comfortable.
Why.item1Body: See your fixed fare before you book. No taximeter surprises during your journey.
Why.item2Body: Enter your trip details, confirm your ride and you're ready to go.
Why.item3Body: We focus on rides to and from Schiphol and destinations around Amsterdam.

AmsterdamTaxi.title: Need a taxi in Amsterdam?
AmsterdamTaxi.body: Schiphol isn't required: you can book AMS Airport Ride just as easily for a regular taxi ride within Amsterdam itself.
AmsterdamTaxi.example6: or any other address in Amsterdam
AmsterdamTaxi.outro: Enter your pickup and destination to see your price right away — based on distance and travel time.
